data.name: Sproyt
data.detailed_description:
Guide life from its earliest spark to its place among the stars in a universe shaped by your decisions. What begins as a fragile organism struggling to survive can become a dominant species, a thriving civilization, or a force that reshapes the galaxy itself.

Experience six distinct stages of evolution: Microbe, Aquatic, Creature, Tribal, Civilization, and Space. Each stage introduces new systems, challenges, and ways to play. Adapt in dynamic ecosystems, evolve from water to land, form societies, expand across continents, and eventually venture beyond your homeworld.

With accessible yet powerful creation tools, you shape bodies, abilities, structures, vehicles, and spacecraft that directly affect how you survive, interact, and expand. A predator built for speed hunts differently than a social species built for cooperation. A civilization focused on industry grows differently than one driven by science or diplomacy.

CREATE living organisms, thriving settlements, advanced cities, and interstellar fleets, all defined by your choices.

EVOLVE across six transformative eras, where adaptations and decisions echo into the future of your species.

EXPLORE oceans, continents, and a vast galaxy filled with new worlds, unknown lifeforms, and opportunities for alliance or conflict.

Your universe does not simply exist, it becomes what you make of it.

data.short_description: Shape life from the very first cell and forge your destiny across the stars in this expansive evolution adventure. From microscopic beginnings to commanding a galactic empire, design, adapt, build, conquer, explore, colonize, and rule in a universe shaped entirely by your creations.

Minimum:

  • Processor: 4-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 6-Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6–8 GB VRAM
